column3: the whole object is unreadable: the neighbour does not drop the copy, the deleter does not append confirmations and does not remove the tombstone — an unknown outcome is not a confirmation (the tombstones contract garbled); the cause goes to the pass log (layout audit, G-10; rule DF-OUTCOMES-109, the Architect's decision of 2026-10-25)
